name: University of California, Berkeley
description: The University of California, Berkeley is a public research university in Berkeley, California, founded in 1868 as the first campus of the University of California. It is known for engineering, computer science, the sciences and economics.
whyIncluded: the University of California, Berkeley (the University of Canterbury (UC) Berkeley) has run the Berkeley Education Alliance for Research in Singapore (BEARS) at Singapore's CREATE (the Campus for Research Excellence and Technological Enterprise) since 2011 in partnership with the National Research Foundation, and is a public United States (US) research university that features in Singapore-market study-abroad guides.

livingCosts.notes: 2026-27 undergraduate student budget, living in a campus residence hall, 9 months. Yearly: housing $16,640; food $9,388 (meal plan $7,000 + additional food $2,388); transportation $754; personal $4,612 (books, course materials, supplies and equipment $1,342 + miscellaneous and personal $3,270). Excludes tuition, fees and health insurance (SHIP).

programmes.name: BS Mechanical Engineering
programmes.notes: Nonresident undergraduate rate: tuition + Nonresident Supplemental Tuition, per semester x 2; same for all majors. Tuition and the supplement are fixed for your entering cohort (Tuition Stability Plan); campus fees can still change. Other fees = Student Services, Berkeley Campus, Transit and Instructional Resilience fees; one-off = Document Management Fee. Health insurance (SHIP) excluded because it can be waived.

programmes.name: JD (Berkeley Law)
programmes.notes: Nonresident Juris Doctor (Law JD) rate: tuition $6,861 + Nonresident Supplemental Tuition $6,122.50 + Professional Degree Supplemental Tuition $27,285 per semester x 2 = $80,537 (2026-27 fee schedule). Other fees = Student Services, Berkeley Campus, Transit, Law Instructional Materials ($15) and Instructional Resilience & Enhancement fees per semester x 2; one-off = Document Management Fee - Law. Health insurance ($4,103/semester) excluded because it can be waived. JD is graduate-entry (3 years); the PDST is not covered by the Tuition Stability Plan, so fees are not fixed. 2024 and 2025 from the Registrar's 2024-25 and 2025-26 fee schedule PDFs (same components).
